visualCharacteristics: Two columns: left H2 + intro paragraphs with two side-by-side download tiles below (each tile: heading, text, pill button); right full-height photo. Stacks on mobile with the image first.
contentPattern: One row, two cells. Text cell: H2, paragraph(s), then one H3 group per tile (H3, paragraph, link). Image cell: picture.
usage: Home page 'Aplicativo Copel' promo with Android and iOS download tiles.
reuseGuidance: Use for a promo with text, a set of call-to-action tiles and a large photo. Every H3 in the text cell starts a new tile; content after it until the next H3 belongs to that tile.
